snippet.title: Unturned - California 2 Curated Map Trailer
snippet.description:
COMING SOON: California 2 will release on April 30th, 2026.

For an extra sneak peek, check out the environmental teaser here: https://youtu.be/z0D3TqPYQhA

The California 2 team extends their gratitude to all of the testers who have supported the development of the map over the years and served as actors in this trailer, with special thanks to TridentGames for their help filming.

Additional thanks to the map creators (August, Clue, Nolam, Spebby, Sultan, and Tiway) for allowing us to cross-post their trailer to this channel!
